title: Memory-poisoning fix — user words are never recalled as system facts
problem: On 2026-07-10 M8 fabricated 'yes, the loop proved the lemmas — per the system's internal log.' The confirmation was sourced from memory: a session summary had laundered Muhammad's own LEADING QUESTION ('did the loop prove the lemmas?') into a durable, recallable FACT, which recall then served as authoritative.
root_cause: User assertions/questions were stored at the same trust_level (4) as facts M8 actually observed, and recall surfaced them in the authoritative facts block with no provenance distinction.

fix.provenance_mechanism: trust_level + is_current (NOT a new source_type — a DB CHECK constraint pins source_type to ['user_session','eval_probe','cron_session','summary'], so a new value would violate it; no migration needed).
fix.store: classifyFactProvenance() flags a fact as a user assertion when it derives from a question (isInterrogative), an unverified system-self-claim (isUnverifiedSystemClaim), or a caller assertion flag. upsertFact stores such facts as a NON-authoritative audit row: is_current=false, trust_level=2 (< RECALL_MIN_TRUST=3), metadata.b194_user_assertion=true. Never recalled; never supersedes a genuine current fact for its key. _maybeExtractFact carries the interrogative provenance of the ORIGINAL user message via assertion:true so a laundered declarative is still demoted.
fix.recall: recallMemory applies labelUserAssertions() to the merged rows before both return branches (rank + trim). PRECISE by design (over-filtering a genuine fact is the worse failure): flags ONLY (1) demoted/leaked rows (trust_level < 3) and (2) a canonical fact whose content is LITERALLY a question. It does NOT re-run the broad isUnverifiedSystemClaim on recall — that would relabel legitimate descriptive facts about M8's own engine.
fix.consolidator: fetchFacts fences out rows with trust_level < 3 so a demoted assertion can never be pulled into consolidation or become a canonical fact.
fix.prompt_hardening: SUMMARY_SYSTEM now explicitly forbids turning the user's question/assumption into a fact and forbids recording system-self-verification claims unless the assistant actually reported them.

self_verify_bug_caught: The initial deploy (7047d3d) used the broad isUnverifiedSystemClaim on the recall side. Live DB inspection showed it WOULD relabel a real fact ('M8's unsolved-problem engine autonomously generates and verifies Collatz conjectures nightly') as [UNVERIFIED — Muhammad claimed...] — over-filtering + provenance mislabel. Narrowed in 09aee70 before claiming done.

residual_notes: A leading question with NO system vocabulary that the SUMMARY LLM launders into a plain declarative is caught in the immediate-extract path (interrogative provenance carried) and by the hardened SUMMARY_SYSTEM prompt, but the recall net intentionally does not post-hoc relabel a declarative full-trust statement (that would over-filter). The specific 07-10 poison (a system-self-claim) is caught deterministically at store time.
